response.overview: Wael, a Syrian citizen, was subjected to arbitrary detention solely because he hailed from the city of Moadamiyah—a city whose residents were known for supporting the Syrian revolution against the Ba'athist regime. Wael takes us through his harrowing experience in solitary confinement, where he endured various forms of torture within one of Bashar al-Assad’s detention centers.  He remained imprisoned, living under the brutal reality that he would never see the outside world again.
response.title: Dead, Waiting for Rebirth
